name: CustomerWorkflow
description: Manages Customer lifecycle: create, update, and delete.

states.name: Deleted
states.description: Customer has been soft-deleted or archived.

transitions.name: create_customer
transitions.description: Validate and persist a new Customer.

transitions.name: update_customer
transitions.description: Apply updates to an existing Customer.

transitions.name: delete_customer
transitions.description: Soft-delete or archive the Customer record.

processors.name: validate_customer
processors.description: Ensure required fields are present and email is valid.

processors.name: apply_customer_update
processors.description: Merge incoming changes into the Customer entity.

processors.name: archive_customer
processors.description: Perform soft-delete actions (mark as deleted, archive data).
